name: Bold Memberships
summary: Shopify membership and loyalty app by Bold: free and paid tiers, store credit, loyalty points, member pricing and free shipping, gated products and checkout, Shopify POS sign-ups and Apple and Google Wallet cards.
best_for: Shopify stores that want a paid or free membership with store credit, member pricing, free shipping, gated products and checkout, POS sign-ups and wallet cards in one app, and would rather pay per member than a flat monthly fee or a cut of each sale
skip_if: you want to put a large free loyalty tier in front of your whole customer list on a tight budget (each member costs 13 cents a month); you need paid memberships to show up as Shopify orders; or you cannot accept an app that views sensitive customer data and edits orders and store credit
honest_knock: Bold Memberships charges for every member, every month: $0.13 each after the first 10, so a free loyalty tier with 10,000 customers costs about $1,300 a month, and the listing does not say whether free members count. Paid tiers run through Stripe rather than Shopify's checkout; a January 2026 review notes that sign-ups do not appear as Shopify orders. The newest reviews are warm about support, but the 1- and 2-star reviews describe member tags vanishing and customers locked out (2021, 2022), members still charged after the app was deleted (2022), and a 2022 complaint about compatibility with modern themes. The data access is wide, including viewing sensitive customer data and editing orders and store credit. We have not run the app ourselves; this dossier is read from the listing, Bold's product page and the reviews.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-05 on the Shopify App Store listing at apps.shopify.com/recurring-memberships, prices in USD) One plan, called Scale: free to install, then $0.13 per member per month. The first 10 members are free forever, the first 30 days are free, and the listing says there is no flat monthly base fee and no transaction fee. All charges are billed in USD. The listing does not define a member; we read it as each customer enrolled in one of your membership tiers, free tiers included, and that is worth confirming before you put a free tier in front of your whole customer list. Paid tiers collect their fees through Stripe (Stripe is listed under 'Works with', and an October 2024 review says membership fees are refunded through Stripe), so Stripe's own processing fees come on top of the app bill.

compare_with.name: Bold Subscriptions
compare_with.why: Bold Subscriptions is in our dossiers too, and Bold builds both; the Memberships listing names it as an integration. They price in opposite ways. Bold Subscriptions sells a product on a schedule and charges $24.99 to $74.99 a month plus a 0.9% to 2% fee on the orders it processes. Bold Memberships sells access and perks, charges $0.13 per member per month with no transaction fee, and takes paid-tier fees through Stripe. If what you sell repeats (coffee, refills, boxes), start with Subscriptions; if what you sell is a status (discounts, early access, member-only products), start with Memberships, and Bold's product page describes running them together, with perks that switch on when a customer subscribes.
